text:
Sorry that happened. Yes, a replacement plant has its own new 30-day guarantee from its delivery date, so you can claim one more replacement if it died within that window despite reasonable care.

To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit at least two photos (whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. Please note the second replacement won't come with a guarantee of its own.

If you'd like help working out what went wrong, a Plant Care Specialist can give free care advice by chat or email.
